purpose: One common wood image per side guarantees equal wood color across piece types.
processing: Trim transparent margins; normalize body to220x256; add8px transparent padding (236x272 total); PNG palette optimization. No recoloring.

Asset type: reusable blank wooden shogi-piece sprite for a mobile board.
Edit ONLY by removing the Japanese character 歩 and restoring uninterrupted fine vertical wood grain underneath it. Produce a BLANK piece with absolutely no ink, no symbol, no text, and no trace of the former character or its shadow.
Preserve the existing pentagonal silhouette, straight overhead view, proportions, narrow bevel, material color, local lighting and transparent silhouette exactly. Keep the same wood color and brightness, including bright highlights and satin grain; do not shift exposure, white balance, saturation or palette.
There must be exactly one centered upright blank wooden shogi piece on a genuinely transparent alpha background. No outside cast shadow, no painted checkerboard or backdrop, no extra object. Same square canvas composition.
